{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",

    "current_load",

    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is for an upward reserve-sizing study in MISO with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40.0. The study is prepared under the auditable rolling design; numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region MISO, horizon 180 minutes, and shortfall cost 40.0 are supported. The operator explicitly requests preparation rather than immediate reserve values, so the study schema is accepted for the verified numerical workflow.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_step_days_30",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
}
